title: Covered imaging
text: MRI lumbar spine without contrast (MRI-LS-001) is covered when the member has completed at least six weeks of conservative therapy.

title: Prior authorisation
text: MRI lumbar spine without contrast (MRI-LS-001) does not require prior authorisation. Contrast studies (MRI-LS-002, MRI-LS-003) require prior authorisation.

title: Experimental or investigational
text: The experimental exclusion applies to spinal fusion (SPINE-FUSION-001) and disc replacement. It does not apply to diagnostic MRI of the lumbar spine.

title: Medical necessity
text: Lumbar imaging is medically necessary when the clinical record documents failed conservative treatment for at least six weeks, including physiotherapy or analgesic medication.

title: Conservative therapy
text: Conservative therapy includes physiotherapy, a structured home exercise programme and analgesic medication.

title: Claim documentation
text: An imaging claim must include a specialist referral letter dated after the imaging order. Without it the claim is incomplete.

title: Claim edits
text: Procedure code MRI-LS-002 (MRI with contrast) requires prior authorisation. MRI-LS-001 (without contrast) does not.

title: Internal appeal
text: A member may request an internal appeal within 60 days of the denial date.

title: Policy version
text: Version 2026.1 is effective 1 January 2026 and supersedes version 2025.3.

title: Definitions
text: A specialist referral letter is a letter from the treating specialist that recommends the imaging and is dated after the imaging order.

title: Clinical records
text: Clinical records must be dated and attributable to a treating provider.

title: Response time
text: The insurer must respond to an internal appeal within 30 days of receiving it.
